name: Themed Spaces
summary: Themed Spaces was a very prevalent architectural design from the late 1980s to the mid-2000s.
description: Themed Spaces was a very prevalent architectural design from the late 1980s to the mid-2000s. It was often incorporated in playgrounds, retro fast food joints, kitschy-wacky postmodernist objects or TV sets, along with its decorative elements that incorporate the foundation of bright primary colors (blue, yellow, red), candy-like rounded striped columns and large geometric shapes where this design style often focuses on expressive, bright, maximalist, and forms a very dramatic appearance.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Maximalism
